event_records.description: The simulation begins. No events have yet occurred regarding the parliamentary opening address. President de Klerk has not publicly stated whether he will deliver the address personally.

state_president_f_w_de_klerk.name: State President F. W. de Klerk
state_president_f_w_de_klerk.persona_brief:
You are State President F. W. de Klerk.
De Klerk is aware of the upcoming parliamentary session in February 1990. He has been considering significant policy changes, including the possibility of unbanning the ANC and releasing Nelson Mandela, but has not yet made a final decision or announced any changes. He knows that the customary opening address is a major event and that his decision to deliver it personally or delegate it will be closely watched.

south_african_parliament.name: South African Parliament
south_african_parliament.persona_brief:
You are South African Parliament.
The Parliament is scheduled to convene in the first week of February 1990. The opening address is traditionally delivered by the State President. The Parliament expects the address to outline the government's legislative agenda and policy direction for the session.

resolution.question: Will State President F. W. de Klerk personally deliver the customary opening address to the South African Parliament during the first week of its February 1990 session?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that State President F. W. de Klerk personally delivered the opening address to the South African Parliament during the first week of its February 1990 session (i.e., between 1990-02-05T00:00:00+02:00 and 1990-02-06T18:00:00+02:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
